title: A cosmic rainbow over the VLT
caption: The Milky Way arching over the Very Large Telescope, Paranal Observatory, Chile
celestial: Photograph taken at Paranal Observatory, Chile

recognition.text: ESO Picture of the Week (an editorial selection, not an audience score).

story: Just right of center in this panorama, the four Unit Telescopes of ESO's Very Large Telescope (VLT) pose in front of a vast expanse of the Milky Way, which arches over the site almost like a rainbow made of stars.

The four smaller Auxiliary Telescopes are in the picture too, and spotting them is a small challenge for the viewer. They can be moved around on tracks across the telescope platform, so astronomers can arrange them in different configurations to suit their observations.

The photograph was taken at ESO's Paranal Observatory, which sits proudly on top of Cerro Paranal, 2635 meters high, in the Atacama Desert of northern Chile. Credited to ESO/P. Horálek, the panorama sets the telescopes against the very sky they are built to explore.

understand.summary: This is a ground-based panoramic photograph credited to ESO/P. Horálek. The source does not publish camera, exposure or color-processing details.
understand.eye: A panorama takes in more sky than the eye can at once, and a camera gathering light over time may show the Milky Way more brightly than an observer would.
